progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk3 and dwells most on Gk in Chaharmezrab. The line peaks at Ab4 (420.3 Hz) at 2:48.5. It closes on Eb3, not the tonic (Eb4 → Ab3 → Eb4 → Ab3 → Gk4 → Eb3).
